updates.title: Editor and Project Foundation
updates.summary: Events, reusable Presets and an internal Placement workspace start forming one connected workflow.
updates.body: The main goal during this stage was to make Event projects feel persistent instead of temporary. Events could be saved and re-opened, Presets could be reused, and Placement became the internal editor route rather than a normal public sidebar page. The workflow was still being refined, but the separation between an Event project and a temporary Preset Workspace became an important rule.

updates.title: Addon-First Direction
updates.summary: Optional event systems should register with Core instead of being permanently hard-coded.
updates.body: The addon foundation was kept intentionally broad: props, Presets, tools, hints, live panels, settings, themes and registered actions can grow around the Core. This lets future packs stay optional and keeps framework-specific integrations separate.
